recursive_hash_note: Manifest does not self-hash; baseline mapping pins original export blobs; final local commit pins the complete updated staging tree.

changes: Directory/import/CLI pathroots and output ownership; method-specific main training instead of historical broad comparison runs.
Small original final head parameters exported non-executable numeric JSON, no refitting; trusted hash/size binding and synthetic margin parity.
Shared frozen joins retained for total arithmetic; exact per-method materialized views co-located.
Historical original source hashes are origin evidence, never a claim path-rewritten export is byte-identical.
Public pretrained acquisition full-SHA pinned; no Git/LFS/public-backbone export.
App backend/frontend unified under dashboard; loopback read-only start; infra reserved hosting.
migration.training_scope: Method-specific fixed representation OOF uses same folds/head grid; historical multi-architecture searches preserved as separate experiments, not automatically rerun. ResNet baselineC1 and nestedC[.01,.1,1,10], other fixed candidates same six logistic/SVM grid; serving original hashes unchanged.

disclosures: New optional environment only; original CPU/runtime locks unchanged.
Frozen baseline source and migration retain their original semantics; new experiment independently versioned.
Numeric SigLIP2 full22 head explicitly safe-schema/hash/size bound; ops independently reviews before external publication.
DINOv3 unrun access-blocked401, no gate bypass or terms acceptance.
